WITH sp_revenue AS (
  SELECT SUM(oi.price) as total_revenue
  FROM orders o
  JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id

    AND o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
),
rj_revenue AS (
  SELECT SUM(oi.price) as total_revenue
  FROM orders o
  JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
  WHERE c.customer_state = 'RJ'
    AND o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
)
SELECT 
  'SP' as state,
  sp_revenue.total_revenue as revenue_sp
FROM sp_revenue
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  'RJ' as state,
  rj_revenue.total_revenue as revenue_rj
FROM rj_revenue
